newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez-Lyonnaise in merger mode to cut time.
newsitem.headline: Suez-Lyonnaise in merger mode to cut time.

text.p: French utilities group Lyonnaise des Eaux and holding company Cie de Suez will join forces through a merger rather than a share swap, in order to speed up their marriage, a source close to the deal said on Friday.
"With a share swap, we have to submit a bid, and then wait for the investors to turn in their shares. Then we have to make a minority buy-out bid. That takes time," the source said.
"With a merger. investors have no choice but to turn in their shares. If they don't agree with the merger, they can sell off their new shares afterwards," the source said.
